RM pelvi: stadiazione di un carcinoma de: Pelvic MRI: staging of cervical carcinoma
Carcinoma squamoso della cervice uterina: Locally advanced squamous cell carcinoma of the uterine cervix (FIGO IIB)
Donna di 39 anni con perdite ematiche va: 39-year-old woman with vaginal bleeding. Biopsy of a cervical lesion: squamous cell carcinoma. Pelvic MRI for local staging (endovaginal gel; available sequences: sagittal T2, high-resolution oblique axial T2, axial T1).
Referta in ordine: tumore, parametri e o: Report in order: tumor, parametria and adjacent organs, conclusion.
Nella stadiazione del carcinoma della ce:
In staging of cervical carcinoma, MRI (especially high-resolution T2 oriented perpendicular to the cervical canal) serves to measure the tumor and decide whether it is operable.
The normal cervix has a fibrous stroma that is hypointense on T2: if the hypointense ring is preserved all around the tumor, parametrial invasion can be excluded with good reliability. Signs of invasion: full-thickness interruption of the stromal ring, spiculated or nodular margins in the parametrial fat, encasement of the uterine vessels.
FIGO stages that change therapy: IIB (parametria) → chemoradiotherapy instead of surgery; IIIA lower third of the vagina; IIIB pelvic wall or hydronephrosis (always check the ureters); IIIC pelvic or para-aortic lymph nodes (FIGO 2018); IVA bladder or rectal mucosa.
Endovaginal gel distends the fornices and helps assess vaginal extension.
Anello stromale ipointenso integro = par: Intact hypointense stromal ring = parametria free; interrupted with spiculations in the fat = IIB, chemoradiotherapy.
Carcinoma squamoso della cervice, stadio: Squamous cell carcinoma of the cervix, FIGO stage IIB (TCGA clinical data from the TCGA-CESC collection).
Tumore primitivo: cosa osservi?: Primary tumor: what do you see?

Voluminosa massa cervicale di circa 8 cm: Large cervical mass of about 8 cm, intermediate signal on T2, replacing the cervix and expanding the lower uterine segment
Sottile ispessimento endometriale senza: Thin endometrial thickening without a cervical mass
Massa ben capsulata a segnale molto bass: Well-encapsulated mass with very low signal on T2 with a "whorled" appearance (leiomyoma)
Margini irregolari con spiculature nel g: Irregular margins with spiculations in the left parametrial fat (suspected parametrial invasion)
Piani adiposi con vescica e retto conser: Fat planes with bladder and rectum preserved; bladder and rectal walls regularly hypointense
Infiltrazione della mucosa vescicale con: Infiltration of the bladder mucosa with tissue protruding into the lumen
Carcinoma della cervice localmente avanz: Locally advanced cervical carcinoma with parametrial invasion (FIGO IIB): indication for concurrent chemoradiotherapy, not radical hysterectomy
Carcinoma della cervice confinato alla c: Cervical carcinoma confined to the cervix (FIGO IB): radical hysterectomy
Sottile ispessimento endometriale regola: Thin, regular endometrial thickening, without a cervical mass or change in stromal signal
Massa ben capsulata a segnale molto bass: Well-encapsulated mass with very low T2 signal and a whorled appearance, as from a cervical leiomyoma
Carcinoma della cervice confinato alla c: Cervical carcinoma confined to the cervix, with an intact stromal ring (FIGO IB): indication for radical hysterectomy
Leiomioma cervicale degenerato con aree: Degenerated cervical leiomyoma with areas of necrosis: benign lesion, myomectomy or gynaecological follow-up
Sottile ispessimento endometriale regola: Thin regular endometrial thickening, with a cervix of normal size, without a cervical mass or change in stromal signal
Massa ben capsulata di circa 5 cm a segn: Well-encapsulated mass of about 5 cm with very low T2 signal and a whorled appearance, displacing the cervix, as from a leiomyoma
Carcinoma della cervice confinato alla c: Cervical carcinoma confined to the cervix, with an intact stromal ring and free parametria (FIGO IB): indication for radical hysterectomy with lymphadenectomy
